title: Unify Zwischenbericht Literaturverzeichnis into Conventional Hyperlinked Bibliography
description: Replace the mit-bestand Zwischenbericht's bespoke Literaturverzeichnis table (custom key-harvest + private counter in print/tex/semio-window.sty, disconnected from biblatex's own cite anchors) with a conventional \printbibliography-driven numbered bibliography. Add accent-colored hyperref link styling (semio-primary) for citations/urls/internal refs. Fully clean up references.bib: strip author-duplicating title prefixes, add derivable years, add urldate to all @online entries, convert the one doi.org URL into a proper doi field. Remove now-dead reference-table macros in semio-table.sty and semio-core.sty. Keep zwischenbericht.tex and zwischenbericht-dark.tex line-identical (no changes expected there, \SemioReferences macro name stays). Verify both light/dark PDFs build clean via Tectonic (bunx nx run print:build) with no undefined citation warnings, and that in-text [n] citations now hyperlink to the visible bibliography entries.
summary: Replaced the bespoke Literaturverzeichnis table (custom key-harvest + private counter, whose \cite links pointed at invisible anchors) with a real biblatex \printbibliography-driven numbered bibliography, styled via a conventional defbibenvironment inside the existing semio window chrome. Added \hypersetup colorlinks (semio-primary) so citations/URLs/cross-refs render as clickable accent-colored links on both light and dark themes. Fully cleaned references.bib (74 entries): stripped author-duplicating title prefixes, added urldate to all @online entries ("besucht am 20.07.2026"), converted all 6 doi.org URLs to proper doi fields, added a derivable year to cirkla-swiss-inv. Removed now-dead reference-table macros (SemioTableReferenceRow/SemioTableReference, colspec@reference(@long), nry table-spec branch, semio_references_* harvest machinery, register-header-reference/year/number localizations). Verified: bunx nx run @semio-tech/mit-bestand-bericht:build succeeds for both zwischenbericht.tex and zwischenbericht-dark.tex via Tectonic with clean bibtex logs (0 undefined citations/warnings); confirmed via PyMuPDF that all 81 in-text citation link destinations (cite.0@<key>) resolve onto the visible Literaturverzeichnis page in both PDFs, and that bibliography/citation text renders in semio-primary (0xff344f) on both themes.
